title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: open — NT reply; Rom 5:12ff only possible locus
pass_a_gloss: Cap. IX opens Placeus's reply to New Testament arguments for immediate imputation of Adam's first actual sin to all humans. You next provoke with NT proofs, and from nowhere but Rom. 5:12 and following. Indeed if any place in all Scripture could yield immediate imputation of that first actual sin to the whole human race, this is surely the one.
pass_b_english: CHAPTER IX. Reply to the Arguments which for the immediate imputation of the first actual sin to all humans are drawn from the New Testament. You next provoke with arguments sought from the New Testament, and from nowhere else than from Rom. 5:12 and following. Indeed if there is any place in all Scripture from which the immediate imputation of the first actual sin to the whole human race could be made out, this is surely the one.
source_text: CAPUT IX. Responsio ad Argumenta, quae pro primi peccati actualis immediata omnibus hominibus imputatione ducuntur e Novo Testamento. Provocas deinceps argumentis e Novo Testamento petitis, nec aliunde quam ex Rom. v. 12. & seqq. Revera si quis est in tota scriptura locus, unde primi peccati actualis imputatio immediata toti generi humano confici possit, hic profecto unus est.

choices.choice: NT reply; Rom 5:12ff only possible locus for immediate imputation
